name: Entropy Undone
descriptionTemplate: Ramona: Timeworn gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: When Ramona: Timeworn plays a card without triggering {Loop}, she gains 1 stack of {Negentropy} and gain [Arg2] Keyflare, up to 3 times per turn.
lore:
In the countless cycles, she tightens the ties of attribution to herself, gradually sinking into the swamp of cause and effect.
Paradoxes tear at her body, chaos fills her soul, and in endless pain, she grasps a glimmer of light shed by the "unknown."
